caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded, bulbous body that tapers towards the base and neck. The neck is relatively short with a small circular opening at the top. A single handle is attached at the neck, curving down and attaching to the shoulder of the jug. The jug is rendered in muted beige and earthy brown tones, with areas of darker brown and grayish discoloration or marks on the surface, possibly indicating age or glazing effects. There are faint brush-like strokes in dark brown on the upper left part of the jug. The background is a plain, light cream color, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition. The artist's signature, "Geo. Loughridge," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Tan Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
